messages.subject: Re: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thanks for your email.

We have a limited budget for live acts, please can you let me know your charges / singing times for a Friday or Saturday evening.

I look forward to hearing back from you.

Many thanks
Terry
Club Secretary
